To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“the tensile strength and elongation of the Al-Si alloy were significantly improved by adding Sr,Nb and Ce”.
the tensile strength of Al-Si cylinder material decreases with the increase of temperature, and the plasticity of the material decreases when the temperature is between 305 ℃ and 418 ℃.
the microstructure of the material changes significantly at the temperature range from 305 ℋ to 418 ℋ.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermo plasticity behavior of the micro-alloyed Al-Si automobile engine cylinder material.
the effect of temperature on the thermo plasticity behavior of micro-alloyed automobile cylinder material.
the micro-alloying of Al-Si automobile cylinders and the analysis of their thermo plasticity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the micro-alloyed material has a high tensile strength,low plasticity and high temperature brittleness.
the material has a low plasticity range from 305 ℈ to 418 ℈, and in the range the morphology of tensile fractures is obvious intergranular fractures.
the material has a good plasticity in the temperature range from 250 ℉ to 300 ℃.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the material has high plasticity at 400 ℃.
the micro-alloying of automobile cylinder material with Mg,Sr,Ni and Ce can effectively improve the tensile strength of material and its temperature range with low plasticity.

the addition of Sr and Nb can significantly improve the tensile strength of Al-Si alloy,but the section reduction of the alloy is reduced,and the addition of Mg,Ce can effectively improve the plasticity of the alloy,and the alloy with the optimal microstructure is the alloy with the addition of 0.5wt% Mg,0.2wt% Sr,0.1wt% Ce and 0.1wt%Ce.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have demonstrated that the microstructure of the material can be tailored to improve the strength and toughness of the material.

the microstructure of the material has an important influence on the plasticity of the material,and the plasticity of Al-Si alloy material can be effectively improved by controlling the microstructure.
